creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-11: "highlight agent name in sidebar, always keep the name visible thru renames, etc". Clarified 2026-10-16: "agent name" means the word the daemon drew for the pane (`otter`).

A row's first line is the name somebody gave the pane, or else its drawn word, so a rename takes the word off the row. The daemon still keeps the word on the pane's record after a rename (`rename_pane` in `crates/muster-daemon/src/session.rs`); nothing shows it. The ask: every agent row shows its pane's drawn word, styled to stand out, beside any given name. Row labels are decided in the core (`docs/architecture.md`, the roster), so the word belongs in the roster entry rather than being assembled in `Sidebar.swift`.

Related: a_2j16Wb9ox would make the drawn word the pane's unique handle, which is the stronger reason to keep it in view.
title: An agent row shows the word Muster drew for its pane, even after a rename
